scope: Focused source review of the automatic live-refetch change; not a new exhaustive repository security scan
checks: Existing invalidation schema validation remains the only SSE data ingress; events never replace domain DTOs.
Same-origin EventSource, authenticated session handling, CSRF, API decoding and secret containment are unchanged.
One in-flight automatic batch, one dirty trailing bit and at most one scheduled refresh bound pending work.
Automatic refresh no longer aborts an existing read whose admitted SQLite work cannot be cancelled.
Events during a slow batch schedule a trailing refresh after completion; the one-second rate limit is preserved.
Unmount marks the effect disposed before closing SSE and clearing timers; late batch completion cannot schedule work.
Hidden-tab behavior, reconnect/focus/poll recovery and explicit mutation/deletion/filter cancellation remain supported.
Regression uses a real QueryClient/QueryObserver, delayed response, burst events and cleanup; checks receipt, no abort and trailing refresh.
